headline: Manaksia Coated Metals raises Rs 150 crore via QIP
hook: Capital infusion for ongoing operational expansion
summary: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries has successfully raised Rs 150 crore through a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) after the issue was fully subscribed. The press release was formally submitted to the stock exchanges on November 5, 2026. This fundraising exercise brings fresh capital into the company for its business operations. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note the equity dilution resulting from the new institutional share issuance.
why_it_matters: Fresh capital raised, but existing shareholders face equity dilution.

headline: Manaksia Coated Metals completes QIP allotment
